answer_1.quote: We consider abstractive summarization as a conditional language generation task... In this work, we propose a training objective that enables the summarization model to recognize and reject unsupported target text spans.

answer_2.quote: We use FACTCC and DAE for sentence-level faithfulness evaluation, ENTFA for entity-level factuality evaluation, and also report ROUGE-1, novel n-gram and coverage scores.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation based on randomized pair comparison... With the following guidelines, we present annotators with the source and two system outputs in random order: 1. Read the source completely. 3. Based on the source, compare the generations... in terms of level of "factuality"... 4. Select the summary that you think is more faithful with respect to the source document.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to read the source, compare the two summaries for factuality/faithfulness, and choose the more factual one or mark them equally factual/non-factual.
